Problem Statement
Read the number of days and the items made on each day. Print the total items made and the average items per day. 
Description
A factory writes down how many items it makes each day. First read the number of days. Then read the items made on each of those days. Find the total items made, and find the average items made per day. The average is printed as a whole number (the decimal part is dropped). 
Input Description
The first line has an integer, the number of days. (1 <= days <= 30). Then there are that many lines, each with an integer, the items made on that day. (0 <= items <= 1000) 
Output Description
Print the total items on the first line and the average items per day on the second line. Print only whole numbers.

5
120

110
